meta.name: Shield wall
meta.text: Allies adjacent to this NPC are harder to hit.

meta.name: Hold the line
meta.text: Stops one enemy from moving past; the enemy must fight or go around.

meta.name: Raise the alarm
meta.text: Calls reinforcements; they arrive in a few rounds.

meta.name: Crushing blow
meta.text: One heavy melee hit that also knocks the target down.

meta.name: Shrug it off
meta.text: Ignores the first serious wound of the fight.

meta.name: Grab
meta.text: A hit may also hold the target in place until they break free.

meta.name: Intimidating roar
meta.text: Nearby enemies hesitate; weak ones flee.

meta.name: Charge
meta.text: Moves fast in a straight line and strikes harder at the end of it.

meta.name: Hit and run
meta.text: Attacks and then moves away without opening itself up.

meta.name: Dirty trick
meta.text: Sand, a kicked stool or a feint: the target is off balance for a round.

meta.name: Ambush
meta.text: Strikes much harder against a target that has not acted yet.

meta.name: Vanish
meta.text: Breaks line of sight and hides, even in thin cover.

meta.name: Poisoned blade
meta.text: The first hit of the fight also sickens the target.

meta.name: Throat cut
meta.text: Devastating attack against a surprised or held target.

meta.name: Slippery
meta.text: Escapes grabs and holds automatically.

meta.name: Deadeye
meta.text: Ignores cover and long range for one shot.

meta.name: Pinning shot
meta.text: A hit stops the target moving next round.

meta.name: High ground
meta.text: Shoots better from an elevated or hidden position and seeks one.

meta.name: Suppressing fire
meta.text: Enemies in a small area are reluctant to move or act.

meta.name: Fanatic
meta.text: Keeps fighting at zero without penalty for one more round.

meta.name: Dark whisper
meta.text: One enemy is frightened or confused for a round.

meta.name: Blood offering
meta.text: Wounds itself to strengthen an ally's next attack.

meta.name: Chant
meta.text: While chanting, allies are braver and harder to frighten.

meta.name: Ranged blast
meta.text: Ranged magical damage to a small area.

meta.name: Bolt
meta.text: A single ranged magical attack.

meta.name: Ward
meta.text: A shield of force that absorbs the next hit.

meta.name: Bind
meta.text: One enemy is held in place until they break free.

meta.name: Blink
meta.text: Short teleport out of reach.

meta.name: Fog
meta.text: Fills an area with obscuring mist for a few rounds.

meta.name: Mend
meta.text: Heals an ally a moderate amount.

meta.name: Shield of faith
meta.text: One ally is harder to hit for a round.

meta.name: Revive
meta.text: Brings a downed ally back to their feet once.

meta.name: Bless
meta.text: Allies nearby hit more often for a round.

meta.name: Stabilise
meta.text: Stops a downed creature dying; works at a touch.

meta.name: Rally
meta.text: Allies that hear the call shake off fear and gain a surge of vigour.

meta.name: Command
meta.text: Gives one ally an extra action right away.

meta.name: Tactical retreat
meta.text: The whole group withdraws without opening itself up.

meta.name: Bodyguards
meta.text: An adjacent ally takes the hit instead.

meta.name: Mark target
meta.text: Allies hit a named enemy harder until the leader's next turn.

meta.name: Jam
meta.text: Enemy devices and comms go dark for a round.

meta.name: Jam
meta.text: Enemy devices and comms go dark for a round.

meta.name: Overload
meta.text: Fries one piece of enemy gear or an augment.

meta.name: Eyes everywhere
meta.text: Sees through nearby cameras and drones; cannot be surprised.

meta.name: Lockdown
meta.text: Seals or opens doors in the area.

meta.name: Animal companion
meta.text: Fights alongside a trained animal that acts on its own.

meta.name: Sic 'em
meta.text: The companion attacks a chosen target at once.

meta.name: Call of the wild
meta.text: Summons a swarm or pack from nearby for a few rounds.

meta.name: Second wind
meta.text: Recovers some vigour once.

meta.name: Parry
meta.text: Turns aside one melee hit.

meta.name: Dodge
meta.text: Avoids one ranged attack entirely.

meta.name: Opportunist
meta.text: Extra attack against an enemy that moves away or stumbles.
